info.name: Ikibaho API
info.description:
Backend phases 1-5 plus the API-readiness work for the client: auth, org membership & invitations, projects, roles & permissions, issues & comments, workflow transitions, pagination & filters.

**Run top to bottom.** Each request stores what the next one needs in collection variables, so you never paste a UUID. Two ordering rules matter:

- Folder 3 (Members) must run before folder 4's role requests — it captures `invitedUserId` and `tokenMember`.
- Folder 5 (Metadata) must run before folder 6 (Issues) on a fresh database: hitting `/meta/issue-types` is what provisions statuses, issue types and the org's default workflow.

**Re-runnable:** project keys and invite emails are randomised per run, and Register tolerates a 409.

Access tokens live 15 minutes. On unexpected 401s, re-run **Auth > Login**.
